blurb: Poway Equestrian Center provides horse boarding with full care and multiple riding arenas. They offer riding lessons and training in disciplines including Beginner Riding, Dressage, Hunter/Jumper, and Reining & Western. The facility includes five irrigated arenas, two round pens, and direct trail access.
